QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Rina, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to greet #b#p201##k, a resident of the town. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the townspeople is a given, right?\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p201#, a resident of #m10001000#. I have a feeling we're going to get along great!

0.0: "Since you've become a resident of #m10001000#, it would be a good idea to go greet the people here. As it happens, I've been wondering how #p201# is doing lately, so please go say hello to #p201#.\r\n- #p229#"

1.0: It's a beautiful day, isn't it? A stroll through #m10001000# would be absolutely perfect on a day like this. But what brings you here?
1.1: Pardon? You're saying you obtained citizenship in #m10001000# and became a resident? Oh my, that's wonderful news! Welcome to our town!
1.2: Let me formally introduce myself. I'm #p201#. I absolutely love everything about this town, and my specialty is cooking. I'd love to treat you to my homemade grilled eel someday.
1.3: Living in such a beautiful town really feels like a dream. I'm sure this is all thanks to #p221# and #p202#. Thank you so much for coming to say hello, and I look forward to getting to know you!

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, doesn't it?
